description: List WordPress options (name ascending) with an optional name prefix filter. Secret-looking values are returned as "[masked]". Note: autoload is only true for legacy 'yes' rows (WP 6.6+ stores 'on'/'auto', reported as false).

prefix.description: Only options whose name starts with this (server lowercases it and keeps only a-z, 0-9, _ and -)

name: mcp_list_options
